summary: Misattributed hourly snapshot caused eviction of hourly-buffer credits on finalized invoice
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports an unexpected deduction and missing hourly-buffer credits on their finalized invoice for 2026-03-09. They saw a ~$12.5k charge labelled 'hourly-buffer-eviction' which they believe should have been covered by their reserved/dedicated buffer for that hour.

Impact: Financial; customer-facing invoice shows a one-off negative credit and provisional balance increased. Customer reports this blocks autopay review for accounting and may delay month-end reconciliation.

Environment: prod, dedicated tenant for NovusDocs in us-east-1. Tokens processed via hybrid batch/stream queue between 2026-03-09T01:00 and 2026-03-09T02:00 UTC.

Steps to reproduce reported by customer: 1) Run multi-model batch job (mixed embed + chat) across two worker pools with tagged warmups and hourly snapshot enabled. 2) During job, a scheduled maintenance caused a transient mux swap (staging->prod) for some postback tags. 3) After job completion, invoice finalized and shows eviction deduction.

Observed logs/snippets: 
- postback-reconciler INFO 2026-03-09T01:12:03Z postback accepted tenant=novusdocs tag=hourly-snapshot instance=prod-05 postback_id=pb_8a7f
- postback-reconciler WARN 2026-03-09T01:12:13Z tag-resolve collision detected tag=hourly-snapshot namespace=default->staging
- rate-selector DEBUG 2026-03-09T01:12:14Z normalized-tag=hourly-snapshot::staging resolved-rate=reserved-hourly-0
- billing worker ERROR 2026-03-09T01:15:00Z apply_credit tenant=novusdocs credit_id=cb_33ff rejected(reason=tag-namespace-mismatch)

Customer-provided evidence: invoice PDF page 3 (line 14) showing 'hourly-buffer-eviction' $12,510. Attached CSV of postback timestamps and tag values.

Initial hypothesis: A recent rate-selector cache normalization change rolled out on 2026-03-08 silently allows tag namespace suffixing ("::staging") for normalized tags. When a mux transition occurred during the snapshot window, some postbacks were emitted with normalized tags pointing to an ephemeral staging namespace; the postback-reconciler later matched those against production hourly-buffers and flagged them as mismatched causing automatic eviction logic to run. The eviction deduction was applied before postback reordering reconciliation could re-attach the buffer credit.

Investigation done so far: 
- Queried reconciler traces for tenant novusdocs between 01:00-02:00 UTC. Found ~312 postbacks with normalized-tag including '::staging'.
- Replayed postback window in staging replay environment; reproduced rejection path.
- Cross-checked invoice finalization logs: billing job invoked eviction step at 2026-03-09T01:16:22Z referencing reconciler output snapshot id ss_20260309_01.

Next steps recommended: 
1) Engineering to pause automated eviction for the affected tenant pending manual reconciliation. (Done: temporary hold placed.)
2) Reprocess reconciler snapshot ss_20260309_01 with namespace guard to re-attach valid hourly credits.
3) Roll back rate-selector normalization patch to previous behavior or add explicit tag namespace whitelist for hourly-snapshot tags.
4) Issue provisional credit and update invoice if reprocessing confirms misattribution.

Time-sensitive asks: customer requests provisional credit and invoice hold until 2026-03-11 (SLA date).
comments: 2026-03-10 09:17 - Maya Chen (support): Opened ticket after NovusDocs escalated via account manager. Collected invoice PDF and postback CSV. Requested immediate hold on autopay and eviction steps.

2026-03-10 10:02 - Billing (Aisha Patel): Placed provisional hold on invoice finalization for tenant novusdocs. Confirmed hold id HOLD-7712. Noted that automated eviction already ran; will await reconciler replay.

2026-03-10 13:30 - Eng (Luca Romano): Reproduced in replay. Found normalization suffix '::staging' appended by rate-selector v2.1. Rolled back v2.1 on canary pool and added namespace guard. Preparing reprocess job (PR referenced).

2026-03-11 02:07 - Billing (Aisha Patel): After reprocess run, 298 of 312 postbacks matched and hourly-buffer credits reattached. Provisional credit $12,510 applied to account pending final audit. Updated invoice to reflect credit; customer notified. Remaining 14 postbacks require manual review.
2026-03-12 11:45 - Customer (NovusDocs Accounting): Acknowledged provisional credit; asked for written postmortem and assurance this won't recur for month-end close.
resolution: Temporary hold applied to tenant autopay. Engineering rolled back rate-selector normalization on canaries and added tag namespace whitelist for 'hourly-snapshot' tags; postback-reconciler replay reattached most credits. Billing issued provisional credit of $12,510 and updated the invoice. Remaining 14 postbacks placed into manual review queue; customer offered weekly reconciliation sync. Follow-ups: (1) infra PR #4123 adds unit tests and namespace guard; (2) add monitoring alert on postback tag namespace collisions; (3) update runbook to pause eviction on tenant invoice hold.
follow_up_actions: Create alert: postback.tag_namespace_collision rate > 5/min for any tenant
Manual audit for remaining 14 postbacks and apply credits if validated
